results.title: Snap Earnings: Q3 Revenue $1.72bn, Back to Profit | TSN
results.author: TSN Newsroom
highlights:
In brief

- Q3 revenue $1.72bn (+14%); net income $56m; Adjusted EBITDA $383m; free cash flow $164m.
- Average DAUs 495 million (+4%); MAUs 977 million (+4%); full-time employees 4,540 (−13% y/y).
- CEO Evan Spiegel says AI is a “significant advantage” for teams and ads, and points to the SPECS AR launch.

...

North America DAUs were soft at 92 million (−6% y/y), so growth is still coming from elsewhere.

Headcount tells another part of the profitability story. Snap counted 4,540 full-time employees at quarter-end, down 13% year on year, after earlier restructuring. For the nine months to 30 September, the company noted $128.5 million of restructuring charges excluded from Adjusted EBITDA. Common shares outstanding were 1,718 million; including stock-based awards the diluted share count was 1,932 million.

results.title: Snap posts Q2 2026 earnings beat on improving ad sales
results.author: Cris Tolomia      August 4, 2026   2 min read
highlights: The results mark a rebound from a difficult stretch for the company. Earlier this year, Snap cut about 1,000 employees — roughly 16% of its full-time workforce— citing AI-driven efficiency gains, with Spiegel saying the reductions were expected to lower annualized expenses by more than $500 million by the second half of the year. Snap's full-time employee count fell to 4,723 in the second quarter from 5,381 in the first quarter.

results.title: Snap ad prices gain 10% as advertising revenue rises just 9%
results.author: Luis Rijo
highlights:
## The cost structure after the April restructuring

Full-time headcount stood at 4,723 at the end of the quarter, down from 5,381 three months earlier and 5,206 a year earlier. The quarter-over-quarter decline is 658 positions, a 12% reduction. In the second quarter Snap announced a plan to reduce global headcount by approximately 16% of global full-time employees, according to the quarterly report, following headcount reduction and reorganisation plans announced in April 2026.

Restructuring charges totalled $128.5 million: $74.4 million in severance and related charges, $26.5 million in stock-based compensation and $27.6 million in other charges, primarily lease exit costs. Those charges are excluded from Adjusted EBITDA. By function, research and development absorbed $48.5 million, general and administrative $42.0 million, sales and marketing $29.4 million and cost of revenue $8.6 million. Remaining charges are expected to be immaterial.

results.title: Snap Just Turned a Profit - and the Stock Plunged Anyway. The User Numbers Explain Why | AInvest
results.author: Ainvest Technical Radar
highlights: The profit, meanwhile, owed as much to the cost side as to revenue. Snap's headcount fell 13% to 4,540, management said its total cost structure grew just 1%, and the company booked restructuring charges earlier in the year. That is a real achievement, but it is a different kind of improvement than a faster-growing ad business.

results.title: Snapchat Employee Statistics 2026 [Headcount, Layoffs and Revenue Per Employee]
highlights:
Snap Inc. counted 4,723 full-time employees on June 30, 2026, down from 5,381 three months earlier. Between those dates, an April 15 restructuring affected about 1,000 team members.

These Snapchat employee statistics cover quarterly headcount, layoff costs, median pay, team mix and hiring, drawn from Snap’s SEC filings, its newsroom and Revelio Labs workforce estimates.

...

- 4,723Full-time employees at Snap on June 30, 2026, down 9% year over year.
- 16%Share of full-time staff included in the April 15, 2026 restructuring of about 1,000 team members.
- $128.5MRestructuring charges Snap recognized in the six months ended June 30, 2026.
- $369,894Annual total compensation of Snap’s median employee in 2025, per its pay ratio disclosure.
- ~54%Share of Snap’s 5,261 full-time employees in engineering roles at December 31, 2025.

## How Many Employees Does Snapchat Have in 2026?

Snap reported 4,723 full-time employees at the end of Q2 2026, a 9% decrease from 5,206 a year earlier. The count excludes part-time employees, contractors and temporary personnel.

Headcount climbed from 5,061 in Q1 2025 to a high of 5,381 in Q1 2026, with one small dip in Q3 2025. Snapchat reported 493 million daily active users and 971 million monthly active users in Q2 2026.

Snap’s FY2025 10-K put about 54% of its 5,261 full-time employees in engineering roles at December 31, 2025. Snap’s definition covers design, development, support and manufacture of products and processes.

Source: Snap Inc. Form 10-K, fiscal 2025

Revelio Labs builds workforce estimates from public professional data. Its March 2026 snapshot places 44.5% of Snap’s modelled workforce in engineering, 35.0% in finance and operations, and 20.6% in sales and marketing.

Revelio’s model counts 5,533 Snap employees for March 2026, while Snap’s own filing lists 5,381 full-time staff at March 31, 2026. The methods differ, so the two figures are not interchangeable.
